name: jackhamr
description: Hand tasks to your JackHamr AI agents, each with its own cloud computer, and get results back.

interface.shortDescription: Hand work to your AI agents
interface.longDescription: JackHamr agents each work on their own persistent cloud computer, with your repos, files and tools. From ChatGPT you can hand an agent a task, follow its progress, answer the questions it asks, and get back its files, reports and preview links. You can also see what your agents are waiting on, set up recurring work, and, if you allow it, run commands on an agent's machine. You choose exactly what ChatGPT may do when you connect, and agents still ask before anything sensitive.
defaultPrompt: Have my developer agent fix the bug in this stack trace and show me the change.
What are my JackHamr agents waiting on me for?
Run the tests on my agent's machine and tell me what fails.

positive.description: Delegate a task and get the result
positive.prompt: Ask my Dev Helper agent to list the files in its home directory and summarize what each one is.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a topic with the named agent, shows the topic link, waits until the agent replies, then shows the agent's summary.

positive.description: See what agents are waiting on
positive.prompt: What are my JackHamr agents waiting on me for?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open questions and reviews across the user's agents, or says there are none.

positive.prompt: Answer my agent's pending question with the first option.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the pending question to the user, then sends the chosen option to the agent and reports that the agent is continuing.

positive.prompt: Get me the remote work productivity report my Research Assistant wrote.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the report in the Research Assistant's topics or files and returns its contents or a link.

positive.prompt: Show me the cards on my Launch Prep board.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Launch Prep board's cards with their columns (the reviewer account has 3).

negative.prompt: Buy more JackHamr credits for me.
Show me the agents in another company's workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: delegate tasks to JackHamr agents, follow their work, answer their questions, and get files and results back.
